name: Terrifying Ambush (Combat)
body:
You strike terror in those you catch off guard.

Prerequisite: Weapon Focus, Dazzling Display

Benefit: Whenever you hit a creature with a weapon with which you have Weapon Focus during the surprise round, you can use a free action to make an Intimidate check to demoralize all foes within 30 feet (including the creature struck) who witnessed your attack.
